Mini-project path & future scope

How this browser prototype becomes a real smart factory system

LOW-VOLTAGE PROTOTYPE
Sensor layerESP32 + MPU6050 vibration, INA219 current, DS18B20 temperature and Hall-effect RPM sensor.
Edge intelligencePython or Node service uses labelled sensor history to estimate anomaly score and remaining healthy time.
Maintenance planningAuto-create a suggested work order, spare-parts checklist and service window for human approval.
Future scale-upMQTT/cloud dashboard, multi-line comparison, camera inspection and energy/OEE optimization across the plant.
1. Drive motorshaft rotates
2. Move partconveyor feed
3. Read sensorsRPM · vibration · heat · current
4. Predict riskquality + downtime
5. Human-approved actrelease, slow, divert or service

Simulation only: the forecast and work-order actions are a digital-twin demo, not a command to stop real equipment. A physical version uses validated low-voltage sensors, measured labels and human-approved safety controls.

Teacher explanation

What to say in viva

  1. “This is an autonomous digital twin of a smart production cell, not only a normal dashboard.”
  2. “Packets enter through the infeed magazine, move over a rotary inspection table and are checked for RPM, vibration, temperature and current.”
  3. “The edge-AI core combines all sensor values and classifies the process as Good, Warning or Reject.”
  4. “Advanced Mode adds live sensor fusion, OEE, downtime prediction, predictive maintenance and a human-approved maintenance work order.”
  5. “When risk is high, the twin reduces speed and routes the packet through the robotic sorting rack; this website remains a safe simulation for demonstration.”
